# 007 – Level-shifter block (16× SN74LVC1T45), generated by script
- Same cell for every shifter: VCCA/VCCB pin → 0.45 via 0.5 mm above the pin, landing on the pad of the 100n cap that sits on B.Cu right
  under it and into the In2 island (3V3 / VIOA / VIOB); GND pin → via beside it, shared with both caps.
- FPGA-side data (X) stays on F.Cu (right-column parts use one lane in the row gap); DIR lines run on B.Cu lanes in the row gaps
  (0.1 mm necks, they are static); the left column's port-side output (Y) drops to B.Cu and leaves east under the right column,
  the right column's leaves on F.Cu. Nothing crosses inside the block.
- X nets from the 33R arrays routed with `bt route --batch` (16/16 after swapping the order of two).
- Found while doing this: the right-middle 3V3 region and the 3V3 "finger" depended on a corridor that via antipads close off -> zones get reshaped later.
